versions.changelog:
Version 26.0.0 adds focused industry intelligence and practical playbooks for recruiters.

- Added 2026 talent intelligence references for new energy, healthcare, consumer retail, and finance.
- Added guidance on payment terms and collections, plus counter-offer defense.
- Updated the skill’s version and descriptions to reflect the new resources.
- Removed the skill-card.md file.

Headhunter Pro v25.0.0 — Major update for commercial workflow and AI-driven recruitment

- Refactored structure to 12-stage end-to-end recruitment workflow with a clear commercial closed-loop.
- Core principles and quick commands updated and expanded for full workflow coverage.
- New and updated reference docs: AI workflow orchestration, data funnel, compliance ecosystem, talent sourcing, BEI screening, outreach PMCC scripts, onboarding silver medalist.
- Redundant and outdated reference files removed for greater clarity and relevance.
- Enhanced documentation with direct reference links throughout workflow stages.
- Improved modularity for talent mapping, candidate screening, BEI assessment, outreach, onboarding, and data-driven pipeline management.

Headhunter Pro v17.0 is a major upgrade, restructuring the toolkit around a true end-to-end recruitment workflow:

- Complete overhaul from version-stacking to a logical, 12-stage, end-to-end workflow that mirrors modern headhunting practices.
- Sharpened core principles (now 39), emphasizing AI-human collaboration, AI for longlists & human curation for shortlists, critical thinking, and candidate experience.
- Extensive command templates added for bulk resume screening, report generation, cold outreach sequences, interview evaluation, and multi-channel sourcing.
- Deepened coverage of client relationship management—strategies for trust-building, ongoing support, and annual reviews now systematized.
- Expanded practical frameworks for talent mapping, passive candidate engagement, interview assessment, and industry-specific talent maps.
- Focus remains on removing cognitive overload for recruiters, enabling best-in-class performance and talent insights.

Headhunter Pro v15.0.0 introduces major enhancements focused on AI-driven, consultative recruitment workflows:

- Added "Consultation First" Talent Gap Analysis, enabling headhunters to partner with clients before job requisition for deeper business and talent needs assessment.
- Introduced vertical industry assessment, offer negotiation (7 critical questions), candidate Persona framework, and advanced client relationship management tools.
- Enhanced talent pipeline ROI analysis and Purple Squirrel candidate management strategies.
- Expanded quick commands for more comprehensive talent insights and improved workflow automation.
- Updated core principles to reflect latest global recruitment trends and best practices for 2026.
